citations.assessment: Names Elazar ben Mahbai on catching grasshoppers.
The corresponding passage spells Eliezer and deals with identification by a mole.
Parallel on identification by a mole, spelling Elazar.
The grasshopper ruling here gives Elazar ben Achbai.
